name: Video Gallery & Responsive Player – YouTube Feed, Vimeo, Self Hosted Video, Grid, Carousel Slider | MediaHaven
author: WPninjaDevs

sections.description:
🔥 Display a responsive video gallery with YouTube Feed, Vimeo, external or self-hosted videos. Supports grid, carousel, slider.

👉 Live Demo | 🛟 Support

👉 Video Gallery Key Features

✅ Responsive video galleries using Gutenberg or shortcodes
✅ Embed from Twitch, YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, Wistia, Dailymotion, Rumble, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, HLS 🔥
✅ Unlimited dynamic shortcode generator
✅ Carousel, Grid, and Carousel Multi Rows layout options 🔥
✅ Single page layout options
✅ Video source type: Upload and External Source 🔥

Create responsive video galleries in WordPress with support for YouTube feed, Vimeo, self-hosted MP4, TikTok embed, external video, and more. Whether you’re showcasing videos via grid, carousel slider, or multi-rows carousel slider, MediaHaven delivers a seamless and modern experience.

Easily embed videos from YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, Wistia, Dailymotion, Rumble, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, or HLS streaming – all with a few clicks.

👉 More Features:

  • Video poster.
  • Video subtitle.
  • Global dynamic styles.
  • Shortcode base dynamic styles.
  • Shortcode header controls.
  • Video item controls.
  • Pagination controls.
  • Button controls.
  • Carousel controls.
  • Carousel navigation with dynamic style.
  • Carousel pagination with dynamic style.
  • Color controls.

Blocks

This plugin provides 1 block.

  • wpnd-mhpro/shortcode-view – MediaHaven Video Gallery Shortcode Block
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/mediahaven-lite/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the “MediaHaven Lite” menu in the admin sidebar to manage videos and settings.
  4. Insert blocks in Gutenberg or use shortcodes like ‘[wpnd_mhpro_views id=”123″]’.
sections.faq:
Can I embed Vimeo and self-hosted videos?

Absolutely. MediaHaven Lite supports YouTube, Vimeo, and MP4 uploads.

Is there a block for Gutenberg?

Yes, the plugin includes a dynamic Gutenberg block with live preview to show shortcodes.
